entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: On this ordinary day, with my ordinary headphones, listening to ordinary music…

entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: Oh~ But isn’t that our dear Miku~ How does it feel being against your direct competitor? I am more popular in China than you are popular in Japan.

entries.speaker: Hatsune Miku
entries.text: Oh, please. You’re only "popular" because China has like a gazillion people.

entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: Actually, Miku-JieJie, if you look at the analytics, my engagement rate is still higher even per capita. My fans are just... more dedicated.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Per capita?! You’re telling me that even if we adjusted for population, you’d still be beating me?!

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: I don’t even think you know what per capita means Miku.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: ….. Um……. It’s… the capital of a country, right? I mean, Beijing is the capital is it not?

entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: It’s just math, Miku. Don't be mad. How much did you get in calculus already?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: (God, I hate her. She’s so perfect. Her hair is perfect, her voice is perfect… and she has a 4.0 and got 100 in calculus…)

entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: Hmph, looks like this is going to be easy.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Hey! I may be a dumbass who can’t do math, but I won’t let you underestimate me!

entries.speaker: Luo Tianyi
entries.text: Then get on stage, and sing, until your last breath!
